Clubhouse Community Room (coffee + donuts provided!!)

Hi neighbors!! Time to lock in our spring plans together. Here's what we'll cover:

1. Pool resurfacing: pick between the two bids (Will Kessler has both quotes)
2. The Lattice rollout: how residents will reserve the clubhouse and courts online, plus the go-live date (Ximena Tanaka)
3. Landscaping budget: decide whether to cut the fall planting to cover the pool overage (Beth Zielinski)
4. Volunteer sign-ups for the cleanup day (Yara Quintero)

The pool vote and the budget tradeoff could get lively, so please read Will's bid summary beforehand!! Board plus committee leads, 9 of us total. See you there!!
- Grace, Northbridge HOA"},{"spec_id":"spec_0643","text":"🎉 Line 3 Jam Postmortem: Kenji reads out the final report! 🙌 (1 hr)"},{"spec_id":"spec_0644","text":"Kickoff for Driftwood 2.0, agenda in [link]. Blocked the full hour just in case!
